params.body:
## Phone step selector: a strip of eight circles

On a phone (under 768 px) the step selector of the vehicle sheet was a header ("5 van 8 / Foto's") with a chevron that opened a list of steps. Twice today Shane could not tell that it was a choice. This PR keeps the desktop stepper on the phone, restyled as a strip of the eight numbered circles:

- done = filled with a check, active = filled with a ring, its name under the strip ("Stap 4 van 8 / Schade"), upcoming = outlined;
- for a complete vehicle (sections, not progress) no checks and no "Stap", as before;
- 44 px tap targets, 36 px circles; a tap jumps through the same `gotoStep`;
- the strip runs to the edge of the card (the card-body padding as negative margin, `--ui-card-pad`) so all eight fit at 390 px; narrower, it scrolls sideways with the active circle scrolled into view on load and on every step change, no animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`; the layout's scroll-row fade already marks the side with more circles.

The chevron header and its list are removed: the strip is the choice, and a second way would only ask which one to tap. The desktop stepper is unchanged (`.ui-stepper-check` is hidden there, the number stays).

Rule R S1-9.22; test `VehicleFormSheetMarkupTest::test_the_phone_step_selector_is_a_strip_of_eight_numbered_circles` (eight buttons with their state bindings for a given step, the name under the strip, no list, the 44 px and check rules in the CSS).

## Photo editor: no console errors

`layouts/modalApp.blade.php` (the iframe layout of the photo editor) loaded the theme's `custom.min.js` twice, without the `?v=filemtime` cache-buster that `layouts/app.blade.php` has. The perfectScrollbar calls were removed from that file on 2026-08-03 (b97f9e5a), but browsers kept serving the older copy in the iframe, hence `$(...).perfectScrollbar is not a function` and `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'width')` on every open of Bewerken. The script initialises the sidebar, preloader, skin switcher, Bootstrap tooltips/popovers and card collapse; none of the five modalApp pages (photo editor, showroom, relation preview, proposal) has any of those (grep on `data-toggle="tooltip"|popover|custom-file-input|data-action="collapse"|preloader`: 0 hits). `custom.min.js` and `sidebarmenu.js` are no longer loaded in that layout. The main layout is fine: its include is versioned and the current file has no perfectScrollbar call; the `.page-wrapper` min-height code there runs on a page that has the wrapper.

Reproduced locally with the pre-2026-08-03 file and the old layout: the two errors (twice, one per include) plus a `reading 'height'` variant; with this layout the editor renders, Save is in place and the console is clean (the only remaining lines are the image 404 of a local box without S3). `ImageEditorSaveTest` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots (in the worktree, `.playwright-mcp/stepper-editor/`): `before-draft-390.png`, `before-edit-390.png`, `after-draft-tapped-390.png` (draft on step 4: three checks, ring on 4), `after-edit-390.png` (complete vehicle: sections), `after-edit-1440.png` (desktop unchanged), `editor-console-before.txt`, `editor-console-after.txt`.

Tests: `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "VehicleForm|ImageEditor|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity"`: OK (56 tests, 1076 assertions).

## Open point (pre-existing, not touched)

On the phone the sheet of a complete vehicle has no card padding and no white card: `.card:has(.wagenlijst) > .card-body { padding: 0 !important }` (a rule for the vehicle list) matches the sheet because something inside it carries the class `wagenlijst`. The strip handles both cases (`--ui-card-pad` is 0 there), but the sheet itself looks different from the draft's.
params.title: A phone stepper you can read and tap, and a photo editor without console errors
